title: Main experiment
body_text:
The introduction is over. You are now entering the main experimental phase. Your performance during this phase will count towards your bonus remuneration. As a reminder, the structure of the experiment is described in the diagram below.


This phase consists in solving 4 tasks. After each task, you must answer a survey directly related to the task you just performed. There are no right or wrong answers to the survey questions; only your score during the tasks will count towards your bonus remuneration.

Please remind that you still have to answer the questions within an alloted time for each image. Responding faster does not improve your score. However, if you fail to respond within the alloted time, it will be counted as an error.

Remember to use the in-navigator zoom (ctrl and mouse scroll or ctrl and +/- keys) to adjust the page size if not all elements can be seen at once.
